verdict.rationale: mParticle documents Consent Filters and Data Privacy Controls that let privacy leads apply per-destination forwarding rules based on consent/opt-out state (e.g., 'Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present') and references generic data transformation as data enters/leaves the platform, which supports the broader theme of controlling PII flow per destination. However, there is no concrete documentation of field-level hashing, masking, or attribute-level filtering of specific sensitive fields per destination — the evidence centers on consent-state-based forwarding rules rather than granular PII transformation controls. Missing for 10: explicit hashing/masking mechanisms, field-level attribute filtering per destination, and any hands-on confirmation of these specific privacy controls.
